# SEO Automation & Google Crawling Implementation Plan

> **For Claude:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.

**Goal:** Expand Toolk1t's search surface with automated SEO landing pages, data-driven blog posts, and Google Indexing API integration — all powered by Vercel Cron Jobs.

**Architecture:** ISR pages with config-driven content for `/free/*` and `/use-cases/*` routes, Supabase-backed `/blog/*` posts generated by Vercel Cron Jobs, enhanced sitemap covering all URLs, and daily Google Indexing API pings for fast crawling.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (ISR, App Router), Vercel Cron, Supabase (blog_posts table), Google Indexing API, JSON-LD structured data, `googleapis` npm package.

---

## Task 1: Fix Technical SEO Gaps

Fix existing SEO issues found in audit: missing Twitter cards, contact page metadata, policy page canonicals, and tools listing H1.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/layout.tsx:10-22` (root metadata)
- Modify: `app/contact/page.tsx:17` (add metadata export — currently none)
- Modify: `app/privacy/page.tsx:4-7` (add canonical + OG)
- Modify: `app/terms/page.tsx:4-7` (add canonical + OG)
- Modify: `app/tools/page.tsx:4-6` (add H1 heading)

**Step 1: Add Twitter cards and OG URL to root layout metadata**

In `app/layout.tsx`, update the `metadata` export:

```typescript
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL(SITE_URL),
  title: {
    default: "Toolk1t - Free Online Tools",
    template: "%s | Toolk1t",
  },
  description:
    "Free online tools for developers and creators — IP lookup, JSON converter, image editor, PDF tools, speed test, and more.",
  openGraph: {
    type: "website",
    siteName: "Toolk1t",
    url: SITE_URL,
  },
  twitter: {
    card: "summary_large_image",
    title: "Toolk1t - Free Online Tools",
    description:
      "Free online tools for developers and creators — IP lookup, JSON converter, image editor, PDF tools, speed test, and more.",
  },
};
```

**Step 2: Add metadata to contact page**

The contact page (`app/contact/page.tsx`) is a `'use client'` component, so metadata must be extracted to a separate `layout.tsx`. Create `app/contact/layout.tsx`:

```typescript
import type { Metadata } from 'next'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Contact Support',
  description: 'Get in touch with the Toolk1t team. Send us a message for feedback, bug reports, or feature requests.',
  alternates: {
    canonical: '/contact',
  },
  openGraph: {
    title: 'Contact Support | Toolk1t',
    description: 'Get in touch with the Toolk1t team for feedback, bug reports, or feature requests.',
    url: '/contact',
  },
}

export default function ContactLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return children
}
```

**Step 3: Add canonical and OG to privacy page**

In `app/privacy/page.tsx`, update metadata:

```typescript
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Privacy Policy — Toolk1t',
  description: 'Privacy Policy for Toolk1t. Learn how we handle your data.',
  alternates: {
    canonical: '/privacy',

  openGraph: {
    title: 'Privacy Policy | Toolk1t',
    description: 'Privacy Policy for Toolk1t. Learn how we handle your data.',
    url: '/privacy',

}
```

**Step 4: Add canonical and OG to terms page**

In `app/terms/page.tsx`, update metadata:

```typescript
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Terms of Service — Toolk1t',
  description: 'Terms of Service for Toolk1t, your free online toolkit.',
  alternates: {
    canonical: '/terms',
  },
  openGraph: {
    title: 'Terms of Service | Toolk1t',
    description: 'Terms of Service for Toolk1t, your free online toolkit.',
    url: '/terms',
  },
}
```

**Step 5: Add H1 to tools listing page**

In `app/tools/page.tsx`, add an H1 above the grid:

```typescript
export default function ToolsPage() {
  return (
    <main className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 py-12 flex-1">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-8">
        Free Online Tools
      </h1>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* existing tool cards */}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}
```

**Step 6: Build and verify**

Run: `pnpm build`
Expected: Build succeeds with no errors.

**Step 7: Commit**

```bash
git add app/layout.tsx app/contact/layout.tsx app/privacy/page.tsx app/terms/page.tsx app/tools/page.tsx
git commit -m "fix(seo): add Twitter cards, missing metadata, canonicals, and tools H1"
```

**Step 3: Create JSON-LD schema helpers**

Create `lib/seo/schemas.ts`:

```typescript
const SITE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'https://toolk1t.app'

export function buildWebAppSchema(opts: {
  name: string
  description: string
  url: string
  category?: string
}) {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'WebApplication',
    name: opts.name,
    description: opts.description,
    url: `${SITE_URL}${opts.url}`,
    applicationCategory: opts.category || 'UtilitiesApplication',
    operatingSystem: 'Any',
    offers: { '@type': 'Offer', price: '0', priceCurrency: 'USD' },
    isPartOf: { '@type': 'WebSite', name: 'Toolk1t', url: SITE_URL },
  }
}

export function buildBreadcrumbSchema(items: { name: string; path?: string }[]) {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'BreadcrumbList',
    itemListElement: items.map((item, i) => ({
      '@type': 'ListItem',
      position: i + 1,
      name: item.name,
      ...(item.path ? { item: `${SITE_URL}${item.path}` } : {}),
    })),
  }
}

export function buildFAQSchema(questions: { q: string; a: string }[]) {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'FAQPage',
    mainEntity: questions.map((faq) => ({
      '@type': 'Question',
      name: faq.q,
      acceptedAnswer: { '@type': 'Answer', text: faq.a },
    })),
  }
}

export function buildArticleSchema(opts: {
  title: string
  description: string
  url: string
  publishedAt: string
  modifiedAt?: string
}) {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Article',
    headline: opts.title,
    description: opts.description,
    url: `${SITE_URL}${opts.url}`,
    datePublished: opts.publishedAt,
    dateModified: opts.modifiedAt || opts.publishedAt,
    author: { '@type': 'Organization', name: 'Toolk1t', url: SITE_URL },
    publisher: {
      '@type': 'Organization',
      name: 'Toolk1t',
      url: SITE_URL,
      logo: { '@type': 'ImageObject', url: `${SITE_URL}/logo.png` },
    },
  }
}
```

## Task 3: `/free/[slug]` Route with ISR

Create the dynamic route that renders keyword variation landing pages from the config.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/free/[slug]/page.tsx`

**Step 1: Create the free landing page route**

Create `app/free/[slug]/page.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { landingPages } from '@/lib/seo/landing-pages'
import { tools } from '@/lib/tools'
import { buildWebAppSchema, buildBreadcrumbSchema } from '@/lib/seo/schemas'
import { LandingPageTemplate } from '@/components/seo/landing-page-template'

export const revalidate = 86400 // 24 hours

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return landingPages.map((p) => ({ slug: p.slug }))
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params
  const page = landingPages.find((p) => p.slug === slug)
  if (!page) return {}

  return {
    title: page.title,
    description: page.description,
    alternates: { canonical: `/free/${page.slug}` },
    openGraph: {
      title: `${page.title} | Toolk1t`,
      description: page.description,
      url: `/free/${page.slug}`,
    },
  }
}

export default async function FreeLandingPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const page = landingPages.find((p) => p.slug === slug)
  if (!page) notFound()

  const relatedTools = tools
    .filter((t) => t.href !== `/tools/${page.toolSlug}`)
    .slice(0, 4)
    .map((t) => ({ name: t.name, href: t.href }))

  const jsonLd = [
    buildWebAppSchema({
      name: page.title,
      description: page.description,
      url: `/free/${page.slug}`,
    }),
    buildBreadcrumbSchema([
      { name: 'Home', path: '/' },
      { name: 'Free Tools', path: '/free' },
      { name: page.h1 },
    ]),
  ]

  return (
    <>
      <script
        type="application/ld+json"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd) }}
      />
      <LandingPageTemplate
        h1={page.h1}
        description={page.description}
        toolHref={`/tools/${page.toolSlug}`}
        toolName={page.toolName}
        howToTitle={`How to use the ${page.toolName}`}
        steps={page.howTo}
        features={page.features}
        relatedTools={relatedTools}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

Run: `pnpm build`
Expected: Build succeeds. All 15 `/free/*` pages generated statically.

## Task 5: Supabase `blog_posts` Table

Create the database table for storing auto-generated blog posts.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/002_blog_posts.sql`

**Step 1: Create migration file**

Create `supabase/migrations/002_blog_posts.sql`:

```sql
-- Blog posts table for auto-generated content
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.blog_posts (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  content JSONB NOT NULL,
  post_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (post_type IN ('weekly-roundup', 'trending', 'tool-spotlight')),
  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Index for listing published posts
CREATE INDEX idx_blog_posts_published ON public.blog_posts (published_at DESC)
  WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL;

-- Index for slug lookup
CREATE INDEX idx_blog_posts_slug ON public.blog_posts (slug);

-- RLS
ALTER TABLE public.blog_posts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Anyone can read published posts (for ISR pages)
CREATE POLICY "Allow public read of published posts"
  ON public.blog_posts FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated
  USING (published_at IS NOT NULL);

-- Only service role can insert/update (cron jobs)
-- Service role bypasses RLS by default, so no policy needed for inserts.

-- Grant access
GRANT SELECT ON public.blog_posts TO anon, authenticated;
```

**Step 2: Run migration via Supabase MCP**

Execute the SQL in Supabase using `mcp__supabase__execute_sql` (or `apply_migration`).

**Step 3: Verify table exists**

Run: `SELECT count(*) FROM public.blog_posts;`
Expected: Returns 0 rows.

**Step 4: Commit**

```bash
git add supabase/migrations/002_blog_posts.sql
git commit -m "feat(seo): add blog_posts migration for auto-generated content"
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'

export const revalidate = 3600

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Blog — Toolk1t Weekly Insights',
  description: 'Weekly roundups of tool usage, trending tools, and tips for getting the most out of Toolk1t.',
  alternates: { canonical: '/blog' },
  openGraph: {
    title: 'Blog | Toolk1t',
    description: 'Weekly roundups of tool usage, trending tools, and tips.',
    url: '/blog',
  },
}

export default async function BlogListingPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: posts } = await supabase
    .from('blog_posts')
    .select('slug, title, description, post_type, published_at')
    .not('published_at', 'is', null)
    .order('published_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(50)

  return (
    <main className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-6 py-12 flex-1">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-2">Blog</h1>
      <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-8">
        Weekly insights, trending tools, and usage stats from Toolk1t.
      </p>

      {!posts || posts.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-slate-500">No posts yet. Check back soon!</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {posts.map((post) => (
            <article key={post.slug} className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-6">
              <Link href={`/blog/${post.slug}`} className="group">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">
                  {post.title}
                </h2>
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { buildArticleSchema, buildBreadcrumbSchema } from '@/lib/seo/schemas'
import { BlogPostRenderer } from '@/components/seo/blog-post-renderer'

export const revalidate = 3600

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: post } = await supabase
    .from('blog_posts')
    .select('title, description, published_at')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .not('published_at', 'is', null)
    .single()

  if (!post) return {}

  return {
    title: post.title,
    description: post.description,
    alternates: { canonical: `/blog/${slug}` },
    openGraph: {
      title: `${post.title} | Toolk1t`,
      description: post.description,
      url: `/blog/${slug}`,
      type: 'article',
      publishedTime: post.published_at,
    },
  }
}

export default async function BlogPostPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: post } = await supabase
    .from('blog_posts')
    .select('*')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .not('published_at', 'is', null)
    .single()

  if (!post) notFound()

  const jsonLd = [
    buildArticleSchema({
      title: post.title,
      description: post.description,
      url: `/blog/${post.slug}`,
      publishedAt: post.published_at,
    }),
    buildBreadcrumbSchema([
      { name: 'Home', path: '/' },
      { name: 'Blog', path: '/blog' },
      { name: post.title },
    ]),
  ]

  return (
    <>
      <script
        type="application/ld+json"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd) }}
      />
      <main className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-6 py-12 flex-1">
        <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-2">
          {post.title}
        </h1>
        <time className="text-sm text-slate-400 block mb-8">
          {new Date(post.published_at).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
            year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric',
          })}
        </time>
        <BlogPostRenderer content={post.content} />
      </main>
    </>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'
import { tools } from '@/lib/tools'
import { landingPages } from '@/lib/seo/landing-pages'
import { useCases } from '@/lib/seo/use-cases'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'

const SITE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'https://toolk1t.app'

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const now = new Date()

  // Fetch published blog posts from Supabase
  let blogEntries: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = []
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    const { data: posts } = await supabase
      .from('blog_posts')
      .select('slug, published_at')
      .not('published_at', 'is', null)
      .order('published_at', { ascending: false })

    blogEntries = (posts ?? []).map((post) => ({
      url: `${SITE_URL}/blog/${post.slug}`,
      lastModified: new Date(post.published_at),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
      priority: 0.6,
    }))
  } catch {
    // Supabase unavailable during build — skip blog entries
  }

  return [
    // Homepage
    { url: SITE_URL, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: 'weekly', priority: 1.0 },
    // Tools listing
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/tools`, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: 'weekly', priority: 0.9 },
    // Individual tools
    ...tools.map((tool) => ({
      url: `${SITE_URL}${tool.href}`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
      priority: 0.8,
    })),
    // Keyword landing pages
    ...landingPages.map((p) => ({
      url: `${SITE_URL}/free/${p.slug}`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
      priority: 0.7,
    })),
    // Use-case pages
    ...useCases.map((uc) => ({
      url: `${SITE_URL}/use-cases/${uc.slug}`,
      lastModified: now,
      changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
      priority: 0.7,
    })),
    // Blog listing
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/blog`, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: 'weekly', priority: 0.7 },
    // Blog posts
    ...blogEntries,
    // Static pages
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/contact`, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: 'yearly', priority: 0.3 },
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/terms`, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: 'yearly', priority: 0.3 },
    { url: `${SITE_URL}/privacy`, lastModified: now, changeFrequency: 'yearly', priority: 0.3 },
  ]
}
```

## Task 8: Vercel Cron — Analytics Aggregation

Create the daily cron job that aggregates page_events stats for blog post generation.

**Files:**

- Create: `vercel.json`

**Step 1: Create the cron API route**

Create `app/api/cron/aggregate-stats/route.ts`:

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  // Verify cron secret
  const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization')
  if (authHeader !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return new NextResponse('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
  }

  const supabase = createClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
  )

  try {
    // Get this week's stats using the existing dashboard_summary RPC
    const { data: summary } = await supabase.rpc('dashboard_summary')
    // Get top tools
    const { data: topTools } = await supabase.rpc('tool_popularity', { time_range_days: 7 })

    console.log('[cron/aggregate-stats] Summary:', JSON.stringify(summary?.[0]))
    console.log('[cron/aggregate-stats] Top tools:', topTools?.length ?? 0)

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      summary: summary?.[0],
      tools_count: topTools?.length ?? 0,
    })
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[cron/aggregate-stats] Error:', error)
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: String(error) }, { status: 500 })
  }
}
```

## Task 9: Vercel Cron — Blog Post Generator

Create the weekly cron job that generates blog posts from analytics data.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/blog/generator.ts`
- Create: `app/api/cron/generate-blog/route.ts`

**Step 1: Create blog generator logic**

Create `lib/blog/generator.ts`:

```typescript
import { tools } from '@/lib/tools'

interface WeeklyData {
  total_views: number
  unique_visitors: number
  top_tools: { tool_slug: string; page_views: number }[]
  prev_week_views: number
}

function getToolName(slug: string): string {
  return tools.find((t) => t.href === `/tools/${slug}`)?.name || slug
}

export function generateWeeklyPost(data: WeeklyData) {
  const now = new Date()
  const weekAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)

  const startStr = weekAgo.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
  const endStr = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })

  const slugDate = `${weekAgo.toISOString().slice(5, 10)}-${now.toISOString().slice(5, 10)}-${now.getFullYear()}`
  const slug = `weekly-${slugDate}`

  const overallChange = data.prev_week_views > 0
    ? Math.round(((data.total_views - data.prev_week_views) / data.prev_week_views) * 100)
    : 0

  // Find the biggest mover
  let highlight: string | null = null
  if (data.top_tools.length > 0) {
    const top = data.top_tools[0]
    highlight = `${getToolName(top.tool_slug)} was the most-used tool with ${top.page_views.toLocaleString()} uses this week.`
  }

  const top5 = data.top_tools.slice(0, 5).map((t) => ({
    name: getToolName(t.tool_slug),
    slug: t.tool_slug,
    views: t.page_views,
    change_pct: 0, // Would need previous week per-tool data for accurate comparison
  }))

  return {
    slug,
    title: `Toolk1t Weekly: ${startStr} – ${endStr}`,
    description: `${data.total_views.toLocaleString()} tool uses and ${data.unique_visitors.toLocaleString()} visitors this week. See trending tools and usage stats.`,
    post_type: 'weekly-roundup' as const,
    content: {
      hero_stat: `${data.total_views.toLocaleString()} tool uses this week${overallChange !== 0 ? ` (${overallChange > 0 ? '+' : ''}${overallChange}%)` : ''}`,
      top_tools: top5,
      highlight,
      weekly_visitors: data.unique_visitors,
      total_views: data.total_views,
    },
    published_at: now.toISOString(),
  }
}
```

**Step 2: Create the cron API route**

Create `app/api/cron/generate-blog/route.ts`:

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import { generateWeeklyPost } from '@/lib/blog/generator'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization')
  if (authHeader !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return new NextResponse('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
  }

  const supabase = createClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
  )

  try {
    // Get this week's data
    const { data: summary } = await supabase.rpc('dashboard_summary')
    const { data: topTools } = await supabase.rpc('tool_popularity', { time_range_days: 7 })

    const s = summary?.[0] || { total_views_7d: 0, unique_visitors_7d: 0 }

    // Get previous week for comparison
    const { data: prevTools } = await supabase.rpc('tool_popularity', { time_range_days: 14 })
    const prevTotal = (prevTools ?? []).reduce((sum: number, t: { page_views: number }) => sum + t.page_views, 0) - s.total_views_7d

    const post = generateWeeklyPost({
      total_views: s.total_views_7d || 0,
      unique_visitors: s.unique_visitors_7d || 0,
      top_tools: topTools ?? [],
      prev_week_views: Math.max(0, prevTotal),
    })

    // Upsert (in case cron runs twice)
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('blog_posts')
      .upsert(post, { onConflict: 'slug' })

    if (error) throw error

    console.log(`[cron/generate-blog] Created post: ${post.slug}`)

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, slug: post.slug })
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[cron/generate-blog] Error:', error)
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: String(error) }, { status: 500 })
  }
}
```

Expected: Build succeeds.

```bash
git commit -m "feat(seo): add weekly blog post generator cron job"
```

## Task 10: Vercel Cron — Google Indexing API Ping

Create the daily cron that pings Google about new/updated URLs.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/seo/google-indexing.ts`
- Create: `app/api/cron/ping-google/route.ts`

**Step 1: Create Google Indexing API client**

Create `lib/seo/google-indexing.ts`:

```typescript
const SITE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'https://toolk1t.app'

/**
 * Ping Google's sitemap endpoint.
 * This is a simple GET request — no authentication needed.
 */
export async function pingSitemap(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const sitemapUrl = `${SITE_URL}/sitemap.xml`
    const pingUrl = `https://www.google.com/ping?sitemap=${encodeURIComponent(sitemapUrl)}`
    const res = await fetch(pingUrl)
    return res.ok
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/**
 * Submit a URL to Google's Indexing API.
 * Requires GOOGLE_INDEXING_KEY env var (service account JSON).
 * Falls back to sitemap ping if no key configured.
 */
export async function submitUrl(url: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const keyJson = process.env.GOOGLE_INDEXING_KEY
  if (!keyJson) {
    console.log('[google-indexing] No GOOGLE_INDEXING_KEY set, skipping URL submission')
    return false
  }

  try {
    const key = JSON.parse(keyJson)

    // Build JWT for Google API auth
    const header = btoa(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' }))
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
    const claim = btoa(JSON.stringify({
      iss: key.client_email,
      scope: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/indexing',
      aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
      exp: now + 3600,
      iat: now,
    }))

    // For full implementation, use googleapis package.
    // Simplified: use the token endpoint with assertion
    const tokenRes = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: new URLSearchParams({
        grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
        assertion: `${header}.${claim}`, // Note: needs proper RS256 signing in production
      }),
    })

    if (!tokenRes.ok) {
      console.log('[google-indexing] Token request failed, falling back to sitemap ping')
      return false
    }

    const { access_token } = await tokenRes.json()

    const res = await fetch('https://indexing.googleapis.com/v3/urlNotifications:publish', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${access_token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ url, type: 'URL_UPDATED' }),
    })

    return res.ok
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[google-indexing] Error submitting URL:', error)
    return false
  }
}
```

**Step 2: Create the cron API route**

Create `app/api/cron/ping-google/route.ts`:

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import { pingSitemap, submitUrl } from '@/lib/seo/google-indexing'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

const SITE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || 'https://toolk1t.app'

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization')
  if (authHeader !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return new NextResponse('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
  }

  const results: { action: string; success: boolean }[] = []

  // 1. Ping sitemap (always works, no auth needed)
  const sitemapOk = await pingSitemap()
  results.push({ action: 'ping-sitemap', success: sitemapOk })

  // 2. Submit recently published blog posts to Indexing API
  try {
    const supabase = createClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    )

    const oneDayAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
    const { data: recentPosts } = await supabase
      .from('blog_posts')
      .select('slug')
      .not('published_at', 'is', null)
      .gte('published_at', oneDayAgo)

    for (const post of recentPosts ?? []) {
      const url = `${SITE_URL}/blog/${post.slug}`
      const ok = await submitUrl(url)
      results.push({ action: `submit-${post.slug}`, success: ok })
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[cron/ping-google] Error fetching posts:', error)
    results.push({ action: 'fetch-posts', success: false })
  }

  console.log('[cron/ping-google] Results:', JSON.stringify(results))

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, results })
}
```

Expected: Build succeeds.

## Post-Implementation: Manual Setup

After all tasks are complete, these one-time manual steps are needed:

1. **Google Search Console** — Verify `toolk1t.app` ownership, add the `google-site-verification` meta tag
2. **Google Cloud Project** — Create project, enable Indexing API, create service account
3. **Vercel Environment Variables** — Add `GOOGLE_INDEXING_KEY` (service account JSON) and `GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION` (verification code)
4. **Supabase Service Role Key** — Add `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` to Vercel for cron jobs that insert blog posts
